about_the_game:
In the twilight between the fall of Kediri and the rise of Singasari, a cursed age unfurled when the shadow of Ken Arok's ambition stirred ancient blood and the soul-bound keris of Mpu Gandring whispered through the veil. Kingdoms crumbled as the cursed blade claimed lineage after lineage, and from its steel was wrought the first fracture, an opening gate to Naraka, where the damned clawed toward the living world. An era not of men, but of fate-bound revenants, where power was paid in blood and every throne was a pyre.

A Souls-like Combat System

Every battle is a fight for survival. Master the art of combat in a world where precision, timing, and strategic thinking are paramount. Whether you wield ancient weapons, channel forgotten magics, or rely on the martial arts of Nusantara, you must adapt to survive the overwhelming onslaught of Hell minions and monstrous creations.

Corrupted Mythology and History

Singhasari, once a kingdom of pride and glory, now lies in ruins. its gods and spirits corrupted by Arok’s dark influence. Discover ancient shrines, ruined temples, and forgotten cities as you uncover the twisted history of Nusantara.

Ancient Weapons and Powers

Channel the powers of Nusantara’s forgotten gods or wield legendary weapons lost to time. Every artifact you find carries the imprint of the past. Equip yourself wisely, for every choice can mean life or death in your final confrontation.

Challenging, Soulslike Difficulty

The world is ruthless, and so are the enemies within it. Learn from your mistakes, adapt your tactics, and prepare for intense battles where every misstep can be fatal.

The Rise of a Dark King

Ken Arok, once a hero of humble origins, has become the villain of legend. His lust for power and betrayal of the gods has condemned Singhasari and all of Nusantara to ruin. As a champion of fate, it is your destiny to bring an end to his reign. But beware, for in a world where corruption reigns supreme, the line between savior and destroyer is thinner than you think.

Will you break the chains of Kala Vikrti and free the kingdom from Arok’s dark rule? Or will you succumb to the same ambition that destroyed him?

The battle for Singhasari’s soul begins now.
